item.title: Police: Woman dies after crash on Fox Hill Road in Hampton

item.title: 'We honor his service and sacrifice': Soldier with Virginia ties killed during operation in Kuwait
item.description: A man with ties to Spotsylvania County was killed after an Iranian strike in Kuwait, according to Gov. Abigail Spanberger (D) and U.S. Senators Mark Warner and Tim Kaine (Both D-Va.).

item.title: Norfolk Police investigating fatal motorcycle crash on Terminal Boulevard
item.description: A 24-year-old motorcyclist was killed in a two-vehicle crash at the intersection of Terminal Boulevard and Ruthven Road late Saturday night, and the driver of the sedan was uninjured.

item.title: Kempsville Road reopens after serious motorcycle crash in Chesapeake
item.description: A motorcyclist was seriously injured in a collision with a vehicle making a left-hand turn at the intersection of Kempsville Road and Hunningdon Lakes Boulevard, resulting in the closure of the westbound lanes of Kempsville Road.

item.title: Soldier becomes seventh US service member killed during Operation Epic Fury
item.description: The service member was injured earlier this month, according to authorities.

item.title: Curfew enforcement in Virginia Beach leads to arrest of 37 minors
item.description: The Virginia Beach Police Department took 37 minors into custody during an unplanned curfew enforcement operation at the Oceanfront Resort area in Virginia Beach on March 7 and March 8, according to police.

item.title: Virginia Beach residents report body found in water near Foxwood Drive and Federal Court
item.description: Residents in a Virginia Beach neighborhood reported a body found in the pond off Foxwood Drive and Federal Court Saturday afternoon.

item.title: Man charged after multi-vehicle crash on Independence Boulevard and Holland Road in Virginia Beach
item.description: The Virginia Beach Police Department are investigating a crash on Holland Road Sunday morning, according to a post from the department on Facebook.

item.title: 'It Was Just Mayhem': Witness describes chaos after 6 Shot at Virginia Beach Oceanfront
item.description: Virginia Beach Police are searching for two suspects after a chaotic shooting at the Oceanfront left six people injured Saturday night.

item.title: Virginia Beach police release photos of Atlantic Avenue shooting suspects
item.description: Five individuals were struck by gunfire in a shooting incident in the 1800 block of Atlantic Avenue in Virginia Beach, and police are searching for two suspects who fled the scene.
